svg.aria-label: Issue #04: Train of Four (2025). An Android app that replaces expensive train-of-four monitoring hardware with a phone camera. During the train-of-four procedure, MediaPipe hand-landmark tracking detects the patient's thumb twitches in response to nerve stimulation and scores them automatically: 97% accuracy, no manual oversight, and over $3,000 saved for mid-to-small clinics. Built natively in Kotlin with Dream Team Engineering.
